stories.title: I genitori, 'dopo 19 anni Chiara ha diritto di riposare in pace'

en.title: Parents: 'After 19 years Chiara has the right to rest in peace'
en.summary: The parents of Chiara Poggi expressed their wish for the case surrounding their daughter's death to conclude, stating she deserves to rest peacefully after 19 years.

stories.title: Da Wall Street all’intelligence, chi è Jay Clayton: l’uomo scelto da Trump per la sfida dell’AI

en.title: From Wall Street to intelligence, who is Jay Clayton: the man chosen by Trump for the AI challenge
en.summary: A 60-year-old business lawyer and former SEC president, Jay Clayton now leads American intelligence and has been selected as a key figure in Trump's new Super Intelligence Force focused on AI development.

stories.title: Garlasco, i genitori di Chiara Poggi: “Lasciatela riposare in pace. Per noi Stasi resta colpevole”

en.title: Garlasco, Chiara Poggi's parents: 'Let her rest in peace. For us Stasi remains guilty'
en.summary: Parents of the 26-year-old killed in Garlasco stated they want the case to end so their daughter can rest peacefully after 19 years, maintaining that Stasi is responsible.

stories.title: Trump nomina il capo dell’intelligence “zar dell’AI” e lancia la Super Intelligence Force

en.title: Trump appoints intelligence chief as 'AI czar' and launches Super Intelligence Force
en.summary: The U.S. president assigned Jay Clayton, director of national intelligence, to coordinate a new federal AI team aimed at maintaining American leadership in artificial intelligence development.

stories.title: Brasile, 160 milioni alle urne. Lula e Bolsonaro hanno votato: in gioco il futuro del Sudamerica

en.title: Brazil, 160 million voters at the polls. Lula and Bolsonaro have voted: South America's future at stake
en.summary: Brazil held mandatory electronic voting with 160 million voters participating. Polls showed the incumbent president leading the right-wing candidate 45% to 40%, with a runoff appearing likely.

stories.title: Trump nomina il capo dell'intelligence 'zar dell'intelligenza artificiale'

en.title: Trump names intelligence chief 'artificial intelligence czar'
en.summary: Trump announced the creation of a 'Super Intelligence force' and appointed the intelligence chief to lead artificial intelligence efforts.

stories.title: Renzi chiude la Leopolda: “I moderati di Forza Italia vengano con noi”. E a Conte: mai con Trump

en.title: Renzi closes Leopolda: "Moderates from Forza Italia come with us". And to Conte: never with Trump
en.summary: Italy Viva's leader challenged Forza Italia moderates to abandon right-wing allies and criticized the Five Star Movement, demanding guarantees against certain political figures.

stories.title: Peschiera del Garda, incendio al camping Bella Italia: 24 feriti. Si indaga sulle cause

en.title: Peschiera del Garda, fire at Bella Italia camping: 24 injured. Investigation into causes underway
en.summary: A fire broke out at a camping facility in Peschiera del Garda, resulting in 24 injured persons, one in critical condition. Investigators are examining possible causes including candles or mosquito-repelling devices.

stories.title: Trump nomina il capo dell’intelligence Jay Clayton “zar dell’intelligenza artificiale”

en.title: Trump nominates intelligence chief Jay Clayton as artificial intelligence 'czar'
en.summary: The United States is establishing a Super Intelligence Force to maintain American superiority in artificial intelligence development, with Jay Clayton leading the oversight committee.

stories.title: Incendio in un camping a Peschiera del Garda, il drone mostra bungalow e auto distrutti

en.title: Fire at Peschiera del Garda camping site, drone shows destroyed bungalows and vehicles
en.summary: A fire at a campground destroyed multiple structures, vehicles, and vegetation, with aerial footage documenting the fire-devastated area.

stories.title: Verona, incendio in un campeggio a Peschiera del Garda: la lotta dei vigili del fuoco contro le fiamme

en.title: Verona, fire at a campground in Peschiera del Garda: firefighters battle the flames
en.summary: A fire broke out at a campground in Peschiera del Garda near Verona, affecting several structures at the facility.

stories.title: Incendio in un camping a Peschiera del Garda, 24 persone in ospedale

en.title: Fire at Peschiera del Garda camping site, 24 people hospitalized
en.summary: Firefighters and emergency services responded to a fire at an operating campground, resulting in 24 people requiring hospital treatment.

stories.title: Sbarca a Olbia il Sardinia boat show

en.title: Sardinia boat show launches in Olbia
en.summary: Sardinia's maritime fair relocated from Porto Rotondo to Olbia and was renamed the Sardinia boat show. The upcoming edition will be held in the new location.

stories.title: Barcolana, la festa del mare conquista Trieste

en.title: Barcolana, the sea festival conquers Trieste
en.summary: The Barcolana, an international sailing regatta in its 58th edition and presented by Generali, takes place next weekend in Trieste, marking the conclusion of the summer racing season.

stories.title: La stagione più lunga: l’Arena di Verona raggiunge il record di incassi

en.title: The longest season: Verona's Arena reaches record box office
en.summary: The Verona Arena achieved nearly 37 million euros in ticket sales over more than three months of performances, with audiences under 30 representing over 11 percent of total attendance.

stories.title: L’ex fabbrica di rame diventa luogo di cura per più di 100 patologie

en.title: The former copper factory becomes a care facility for more than 100 diseases
en.summary: Dynamo Camp, established in 2007 as a summer facility providing free stays for children with cancer, has evolved over two decades into a treatment center addressing numerous conditions.

stories.title: Posti barca, in Italia sono 172mila ma solo il 2% è dedicato ai superyacht

en.title: Boat berths, Italy has 172,000 but only 2% are dedicated to superyachts
en.summary: Italy has 172,000 boat berths, with only 2% designated for vessels over 24 meters. Liguria and Toscana regions account for approximately half of the superyacht capacity.
